summary: Mosteiros Airport (MTI/GVMT) is a small domestic airfield serving Vila do Mosteiros on the northern coast of Fogo island in Cape Verde. It provides vital air access to the communities on the island, which is dominated by the active Pico do Fogo volcano. The facility supports primarily inter-island regional flights, connecting this remote part of Fogo to the rest of the Cape Verde archipelago.
faqs:
Q: What flights operate from Mosteiros Airport?
A: The airport primarily handles small inter-island domestic flights within Cape Verde, connecting Fogo island to other islands in the archipelago.

Q: Which island is Mosteiros Airport located on?
A: It is situated on the island of Fogo, serving the town of Vila do Mosteiros on the island's northern coast.

Q: How far is Mosteiros Airport from the town center?
A: The airport is located near Vila do Mosteiros and is just a short drive from the town center.

Q: Are there international flights from Mosteiros Airport?
A: No, the airport handles only domestic flights within Cape Verde. International travelers typically fly into Praia or Sal islands first.
transport_tips: Getting to and from Mosteiros Airport is best done by local taxi or pre-arranged transfer, as there is no public transit serving the small terminal. Renting a car in Vila do Mosteiros is a practical option for exploring Fogo island independently. Visitors heading to São Filipe, the island's main town, should arrange ground transport in advance for the longer cross-island journey.
local_tip: If you have time before your flight, visit the nearby black sand beaches of Mosteiros — they are among the most striking in Cape Verde and a perfect way to experience Fogo's volcanic landscape up close.
